hook: Only for People Who Wake Up at 3 AM

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Three A M. <#0.4#> Did you wake up again?
voices.caption: 3 AM. Did you wake up again?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: If it happens at this exact hour for no reason, <#0.2#> don't brush it off.
voices.caption: If it happens at this exact hour for no reason, don't brush it off.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Spiritual traditions call three A M <#0.2#> the hour when the veil is thinnest.
voices.caption: Spiritual traditions call 3 AM the hour when the veil is thinnest.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: People who wake now <#0.2#> are said to be ready to notice something.
voices.caption: People who wake now are said to be ready to notice something.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Next time, skip your phone. <#0.3#> Close your eyes and ask, <#0.3#> what do I need to know right now?
voices.caption: Next time, skip your phone. Close your eyes and ask: what do I need to know right now?

voices.name: l05
voices.text: And of course, <#0.2#> if sleep problems continue, please see a doctor too.
voices.caption: And of course, if sleep problems continue, please see a doctor too.
